text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while after life on the deserted island began.
Mejiro Ryan was crafting something on the sandy beach—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A table and chairs made of palm wood...
Ryan, could it be that you prepared these?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I made it!
I hope it becomes a place where everyone can relax!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, how wonderful...!
May I make use of it right away?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Of course! ...Is what I'd like to say, but
the roof isn't finished yet, so the sunlight's—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, please do not worry about that.
I have my parasol with me, after all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I have spares with me.
Please, feel free to use them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, um—
Maybe I should pass...?
choice_data_list: With this heat, you'd better use an umbrella.
With this heat, you should probably use an umbrella.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That is... true, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (Such a cute and elegant parasol suits McQueen so well, but—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(No way for me! No, no, no, no way!
It definitely wouldn't look good on me...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
A-Anyway!
I'll pass on that...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even while saying that, Mejiro Ryan's gaze remained fixed on the cute parasol...
choice_data_list: Don't you actually want to try running from behind?
Don't you actually want to try running from behind?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? C-Come on now!
What are you talking about, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hit the nail on the head, didn't I?
I can easily tell just by looking at your face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! Even you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"No, but really, it's just not like me...
W-What if someone sees me...?!"
choice_data_list: There's no one here but us right now, you know?
Right now, there's no one here but us, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah... Indeed, now that you mention it...
choice_data_list: If you're worried about people watching, now's your chance!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: A chance...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I see... On this island right now...
I don't have to worry about anyone watching—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Um... Is it weird, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
It suits you wonderfully.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I feel the same way.
Yeah, I feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Nnnrgh!
Even if it's just flattery, that makes me happy...
choice_data_list: I'm not flattering you at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, quite so.
Since we have the chance, shall we have some tea?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected, when the young ladies of the Mejiro family gather around a table,
the elegance is truly out of this world.
choice_data_list: This kind of vibe suits you too, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Really...? E-Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
When you put it that way, um,
it makes me want to try acting more gracefully...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, isn't that nice?
I'm sure it suits you perfectly right now, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Then... *ahem*.
—This iced tea has quite a pleasant flavor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though I have grown slightly fonder
of the sun, which I once resented so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Juuust kidding, haha.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, how lovely.
Why not continue doing so in the future?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Just for right now!
Once we're done using the parasol, that's it...!
choice_data_list: I see... and it looks so good on you, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
D-Do you... think so?
...I'm having fun too, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you may keep the parasol.
Won't you show me again? That graceful side of yours.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you...
I'll do my best... I shall try.
choice_data_list: I want to keep taking on new challenges like this.
Let's keep trying new things like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You're right... On an island with so few people, maybe I could even do things I've never been able to before...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'll take this as a chance to challenge myself with new things!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On this deserted island, she will surely grow. Whenever Mejiro Ryan challenges something new, I'll support her with everything I've got.
